questions.q_en: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral in which PQ = 14.4 cm, QR =12.8 cm and SR = 9.6 cm. If PR bisects QS, what is the length of PS?

questions.solution_en:
⇒ PS × SR = PQ ×QR
⇒ PS × 9.6 = 14.4 × 12.8
⇒ PS = 19.2cm

questions.solution_en:
PQ = PR and QO = OR
So Quad. PQOR is a kite
∴PO and QR intersect at 90 ̊

In △QSO
QO2 = OS2 + QS2
102 = x2 + QS2
QS2 = 102 – x2 -----{i}
In △PSQ

122 = [10 – x]2 + QS2
QS2 = 122 – [10 – x]2---{ii}


Equating eqn. {i} and {ii}
⇒ 102 – x2 =122 – [10 – x]2
⇒100 – x2 =[12-{10 – x}][12 + {10 – x}]
⇒100 - x 2 = [2 + x] [22 – x]
⇒100 – x2 = 44 + 20x – x2
⇒ 56 = 20x
⇒ 2.8 = x

QS2 = [10 + 2.8][10 - 2.8]
QS2 = 12.8 × 7.2
QS = 9.6cm
QR =2 × QS = 2 × 9.6cm
=19.2cm

questions.solution_en:
Given
∠DOC = 60 ̊
Then ∠BAO = = 30 ̊
∠BAO = ∠ACO [OA = OC= radius]
∠OBC = 180 ̊ - 60 ̊ = 120 ̊
So ∠BOC = 180 ̊ - [120 ̊ + 30 ̊]
= 30 ̊
P.T.O.
∠BCO = ∠BOC
So, BC = OB
Given, OB = 5cm.
BC = 5cm.

questions.q_en: In a quadrilateral APQR, the side QR is extended to S such that RS = PR. IfQPS = 110° and PRQ =70°, then the value of PQR is:
questions.q_hi: चतुर्भुज APQR में, भुजा QR को S तक इस प्रकार बढ़ाया गया है कि RS = PR है। यदि QPS = 110° और PRQ = 70° है, तो PQR का मान क्या है?
questions.solution_en:
∠RSP = ∠SPR [RS = PR]
∠RSP + ∠SPR = ∠PRQ [exterior angle property]
2x = 70 ̊
x =35 ̊
So, ∠QPR = 110 ̊ - 35 ̊
= 75 ̊
In △PQR
∠PQR = 180 ̊ - [75 ̊ + 70 ̊]
= 180 ̊ - 145 ̊
∠PQR = 35 ̊
